category_title: Fourth-grade students with behavioral challenges, poor work completion, and adequate literacy skills
minimal_context: The student is in a small group intervention block tasked with creating an after-school schedule to learn about managing time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are learning about Managing Your Time. Please use this paper to create a schedule for your time after school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't need to make a schedule. I already know how to do my reading and homework. I don't even like being in this small group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write down a few things you do when you get home.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away) I'm not writing it. I'm already smart enough and I'm missing my regular class for this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this activity before the session is over. Please focus on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the wall, completely off-task) I don't care. I'm not doing this assignment. This group is a waste of time and I'm not writing anything down.

task.content: Learning about Managing Your Time by creating a schedule for time after school, or Strengthening Your Memory by playing a memory game taking turns repeating names for each letter of the alphabet.
task.learning_goal: Improving self-regulation skills (e.g., goal setting, self-management, decision making).

context.materials: Goal cards, school-wide PBIS tickets, magazine pictures, premade line drawings

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When participating in the small group activities despite having adequate literacy skills and being capable
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibited off-task behavior and had difficulty completing assignments according to teacher-maintained records
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Not enjoying being in the small group

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to complete class and homework assignments
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Underperforming academically and having difficulty completing assignments
